summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.21, Rengar support affiche 47,5 % de victoires sur 788 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier B. Il souffre surtout contre Lulu et Thresh.
summary.en: On patch 16.21, Rengar support has a 47.5% win rate over 788 ranked games (Emerald+), B tier. It struggles most against Lulu and Thresh.
